screen_policy.scope: Screen all 143 r6 records using confirmed name plus EVERY C1/C2 claim line, all types. Restrict selection to committed/held Styling from latest prior lane references (union if disputed). Keep weak secondary candidates even when duplicated by stronger signals; exclude an agreed primary job from scope triggers, and keep disputed/null primaries conservative. Secondary capacity counts distinct jobs excluding an agreed prior primary, before formula gates. Semantic false positives remain for blind resolution.
screen_policy.strength: Name words are strong after collection exclusion. Explicit result promises, emphasis/strength and brand hold numbers are strong. Bare hold, duration-only hold and look descriptions without emphasis are weak. Scope strength labels are conservative reach annotations, never final classifications. Pure feel/consistency/audience/negated-hold matches are logged and excluded by content, never by field type alone.
screen_policy.r9_f: Carry owner-verified gotGloss C2 promise as in r10 before screening and into any selected record/claims packet.
screen_policy.boundary: No classification or scoring, no historical edits, no lock reinstatement. Prior routes/primary are reference-only and never supplied to blind lanes; formula gates remain for those lanes.
